protocol.summary: The official driver performs the VL53L0X register initialization, SPAD configuration, reference calibration and ranging sequences at 0x29. Returning only a range number without the initialization/status path does not satisfy this protocol.
gaps: Full driver initialization, data-ready/interrupt status, timeout and invalid-range semantics still require implementation.
Product states usual maximum 120cm; 200cm requires Long Range mode and suitable environment.
